description: Upload a file and attach it to an issue, project, or comment. Send the file content as base64 in content_base64 (up to 25 MB). Returns `markdown` (a ready relative link such as ![name](/api/files/<id>)): paste exactly that into the issue/comment/description text.

mime.description: e.g. image/png; guessed from the filename if omitted

name: attach_file
